newsitem.title: USA: Airborne Express sets up customs brokerage.
newsitem.headline: Airborne Express sets up customs brokerage.

text.p: Airborne Express has set up a new customers brokerage service Airborne Brokerage Services (ABS) that will offer a full range of customs brokerage services at U.S. customs ports and throughout Canada.
It will offer customers support at all major Airborne International gateways and from six regional offices, New York, Los Angeles, Boston, Seattle, Chicago and Atlanta.
ABS will operate in partnership with Ontario-based Pearce-Bridge Brokerage Limited, the second largest Canadian customs broker and the seventh largest entry filler in the U.S., Airborne Express said.

"We think this is an exciting addition to our international services, it's an important part of our international strategy, because brokerage services and ocean freight are among the fastest growing segments of our industry," said Charlie Ogle, general manager of Airborne Ocean Services, who will also oversee ABS operations.
